levels.description: Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>; enemies within Attack Range lose <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> and <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> stack limit <@ba.vdown>drops to 2</>; ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> and attacks <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target}</> targets at once; when Operators within range activate a skill (including Mantra), enemies within range gain {per_active} stacks of <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> (can be triggered at most {max_trigger_cnt} times); for every 1 stack of <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> <@ba.vup>above the limit</> on enemies within range, 1 instance of <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Elemental Damage jumps between the target and {chain_times} other enemy; there is a short delay between jumps
